title: Multi-cell span support in engine
description: Add first-class multi-cell component spans to both Rust and Python engines. A component with span > 1 occupies multiple contiguous grid cells. Same ComponentId stored in every occupied cell. ComponentData tracks span_cells. Placement validates bounds + no overlap. Removal clears all occupied cells. Grid iteration uses seen-set to avoid duplicate processing. Schema adds span property to component definition. Needed for Battleship ships and any future game with multi-cell pieces (Tetris, fleet games, etc.).
close_reason: Multi-cell span support implemented in both Rust and Python engines. Schema, definition, runtime, transition, and moves all updated. 15 new tests across both engines.
